hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash set -euo pipefail
ART="ninja.txt" JOB1="assignment-1_job-1" USERCONTENT_DIR="${JENKINS_HOME:-/var/lib/jenkins}/userContent"
echo "=== job-2: copy $ART from $JOB1 and publish ===" echo "Workspace: ${WORKSPACE:-$(pwd)}"
# Always take latest build of job-1 SRC="$(ls -1dt /var/lib/jenkins/jobs/$JOB1/builds/*/archive/$ART 2>/dev/null | head -n1 || true)"
if [[ -n "$SRC" && -f "$SRC" ]]; then echo "Found latest $ART at $SRC" cp -f "$SRC" "$WORKSPACE/$ART" else echo "❌ ERROR: $ART not found in any recent build of $JOB1" exit 1 fi
# Publish to userContent mkdir -p "$USERCONTENT_DIR" install -m 0644 "$WORKSPACE/$ART" "$USERCONTENT_DIR/$ART"
echo "✅ Copied $ART to: $USERCONTENT_DIR/$ART" echo "📎 Access at: ${JENKINS_URL%/}/userContent/$ART"
